messages.text: The crown has confirmed Grey Petrel's lodged Relief lift, so the funding objection is answered. I support the written Relief directive. I acknowledge your maintenance and our protection as contributions, but Repair next month cannot be an unquestioned settlement already: it restores the route while denying external passage that month. We must negotiate how the army keeps its strength alongside that repair.
Reserve confirmation resolves my operational objection. Navigation supports Relief. Preserve the council Raid and Warrant alongside it; Vigil must not also be assigned Guard.

reason: Our current arrangement buys food, trade and successful combat according to the disclosed condition. Its route cost is real. I am accepting this round's exchange without promising an army stand-down next month or signing away our institutional claim.
